newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts Atlas Copco.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman cuts Atlas Copco.

text.p: Lehman Brothers on Tuesday downgraded its recommendation on Atlas Copco to "neutral" from "outperform" in the wake of the Swedish industrial engineering firm's acquisition of Prime Service Inc of the U.S.

"Our reservations on the financial logic of this acquisition lead us to downgrade our recommendation on the shares, which have already surpassed our 1998 price target," Lehman said in a research note.
It said it was downgrading its 1998 price target to 190 crowns from 200 and would advise taking profits at this stage.
Lehman said it did not question the industrial logic of the acquisition but rather the purchase price.

It said it also had reservations on "Prime Service's accounting policies and earnings visibility, on the potential additional cyclicality that this gives to Atlas Copco's earnings stream, and on further acquisition activity from Atlas Copco going forward."
